about.title: about
description: I’m a self-taught full-stack developer based in Fergana, Uzbekistan. I build robust, scalable solutions from scratch, covering both front-end and back-end to deliver a seamless user experience.

Turning ideas into end-to-end web applications has been my passion for over 5+ years. I’ve helped diverse clients bring their visions to life online and always keep up with the latest technologies and best practices.
